Criterion 5 follow-up only.

| # | Verdict | Evidence |
|---:|---|---|
| 5 | PARTIAL | Rechecked the exact CI run cited earlier with the full log: `GH_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT gh run view 35383290639 --repo navapbc/rebar --log`, saved at `/Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.rebar/worktrees/verify-0eba-runs/.rebar/scratch/evidence-0eba-c5-14396/gh-run-35383290639-full.log` (`23878` lines). The `ubuntu-latest, py3.13` pytest cell still shows the successful suite verdict: `20347 passed, 82 skipped, 36 warnings in 1303.01s`. Greps over the full log found `sandbox compatibility skips: 0`, `POSIX named semaphore unavailable: 0`, and `sandbox ps unavailable: 0`; the relevant absence is therefore from the full run log, not the earlier filtered artifact. However, the counted-skip summary section is not present at all in that CI log, so there is no summary section to quote verbatim as proof that the reporting mechanism surfaced other counted skips while omitting POSIX semaphores. I followed the requested fallback: `GH_TOKEN=$GITHUB_PAT gh run download 35383290639 --repo navapbc/rebar --dir /Users/joeoakhart/rebar/.rebar/worktrees/verify-0eba-runs/.rebar/scratch/evidence-0eba-c5-14396/artifacts` succeeded, but downloaded only 35 mutation artifact files and `find ... \( -name '*.xml' -o -iname '*junit*' -o -iname '*pytest*' \)` found 0 JUnit/pytest XML artifacts. The log does not account for the 82 skips with per-skip reasons (`SKIPPED` count is 0). This strengthens the evidence that the POSIX counted-skip path did not fire in CI, but it still does not produce the requested direct proof that all 4 named tests executed rather than skipped. Missing: either a counted-skip summary section present in the CI log with non-semaphore reasons, or a per-test CI result artifact naming the 4 node IDs as non-skipped. |
